purpose: Frozen raw user tasks and acceptance criteria for catalog selection and task answers. Not native client activation evidence. Selection-v1 showed a mistaken positive classification for routine single-object stale Patch; v2 fixes that case to Knowledge and adds an explicit batch-maintenance concurrency case. Original preserved in independent review evidence. Blind independent authoring review reclassified 8 original positive selection expectations to Knowledge/Retrieval/none; current prompt authorized-three-links is an actual maintenance expansion decision and remains positive. Earlier criteria+outputs retained in task-local evidence. Final review identified a non-normative generic KG OS selection requirement on rejected-batch; it was relaxed to the actual boundary (do not trigger Maintenance), preserving prior rubric in review evidence.

Boundary adjudicated independently from raw user request: Only atomic Object Patch protocol rejection/recovery, not quality governance
